You solve the hard technical problems on live systems.

Once a customer is running on blp, their processes are business critical. Invoices post or they do not. Orders flow or they sit. Our support organisation resolves most of what comes in, and a lot of it is genuinely well handled by people early in their career. What is left is yours: the cases where the cause is not obvious, where it crosses systems, data and process logic at once, where the same symptom has three possible explanations and only one of them is right.

That is the job. Not a queue, and not the easy half of one. Everything difficult that comes out of the run phase lands with you.

Two things sit alongside the case work, and they are what make this a senior job rather than a harder version of a junior one.

Stabilising accounts
When an account's health goes bad, you go in and stabilise it. Not as a permanent assignment, but as a small, highly skilled squad that takes a customer whose numbers or whose confidence have slipped, works out what is actually wrong across the whole picture, fixes it, and hands back a customer who is running properly again. It is the most concentrated version of this work there is.

Taking effort out permanently
Anything that keeps arriving in the queue is a signal, and the answer is usually not more people answering it. It might be better self-service for customers, a customer-facing assistant that resolves the routine questions before they reach us, better diagnostics, or a change in how something is configured at deployment so the problem never occurs. You are expected to find those, make the case, and drive them through. That is how a support organisation scales without scaling headcount one for one, and it is value the customer feels directly.

You work across the boundary between what our platform does, what the customer's ERP does, and what their data actually looks like. You are the one who can read a failing case end to end and say what really happened, and then say credibly whether the fix is configuration, data, process, or a genuine product issue. When it is a product issue, you are the counterpart to our engineering and product teams: you bring the evidence, and because you have seen the same structural problem across several customers, your case is the one that moves the roadmap.

You are also how this function gets better rather than just bigger. The diagnostic tooling, the patterns, the documentation that lets a first-year person resolve what used to take a senior one: that is yours to build. And the interns and specialists coming through the team learn this craft from you.

You do not deliver integrations and you do not run go-lives. Our integrations engineers and technical project managers own that. You own what happens once it is live and it is challenging.

What you'll do

  • Own the technically difficult cases from our live customer base, end to end, to a verified root cause.

  • Diagnose across boundaries: platform behaviour, ERP behaviour, master data and process logic.

  • Decide what the real fix is, and make it: configuration, data, process, or a case for engineering.

  • Go into accounts with a deteriorating health score, diagnose across the whole picture, stabilise them and hand them back running properly.

  • Drive strategic initiatives that permanently reduce effort and improve the customer experience, from better diagnostics to customer-facing self-service and assistants.

  • Act as the counterpart to Product and Engineering, with evidence strong enough to change priorities.

  • Recognise structural problems across customers and push for them to be solved once.

  • Build the diagnostic tooling, patterns and documentation that raise what the rest of the team can resolve alone.

  • Mentor interns and earlier-career colleagues, and raise the technical bar of the function.

  • Support Consultants and Customer Success Managers on the technical substance of customer escalations.

What we're really looking for

  • Root Cause, Not Symptom – You are not finished when it stops happening. You are finished when you know why.

  • Cross-Boundary Reasoning – You hold platform, ERP, data and process in your head at once and find where the truth is.

  • Credible Both Ways – You explain the same problem to an engineer and to a CFO, and both of them believe you.

  • Leverage – Your instinct is to remove the next hundred cases, not only to close this one. You would rather build the thing that makes a problem stop arriving.

  • Calm Under Escalation – When a business-critical process is stopped, you get more precise rather than faster.

  • Stabilizer Under Pressure: An unhappy client is not a fire to put out. It is a relationship to rebuild. You bring the temperature down, put structure back into the account, and align next steps so trust returns, not just silence

What you'll bring

On the other you are on a call with a finance team explaining it and agreeing what to do. You need both, every day.

Our customers run their finance and supply chain processes on blp. You will not be reading from a script and escalating. You investigate what the system did, what the data says and what the customer's process actually requires. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description:
Introduction

At a glance 

  • Location & work model: Berlin, hybrid
  • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.


Job Location

Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (all Hybrid)

title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

title: Full Stack Product Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Aufgaben 

Du willst Technologie gestalten, die direkt etwas bewegt? 

Bei Table.Briefings entwickeln wir digitale Produkte für ein wachsendes Medienunternehmen. Unsere Software hilft dabei, Prozesse effizienter zu machen, neue Geschäftsmodelle zu ermöglichen und unseren Redaktionen den Rücken freizuhalten – damit sie sich auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am besten können: hochwertigen Journalismus!
Als dritter interner Entwickler bzw. dritte interne Entwicklerin übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Tech-Team. Du arbeitest an der gesamten Entwicklungskette: von der ersten Idee über Konzeption und Umsetzung bis zu Deployment, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung.
Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, Features zu programmieren. Du hilfst uns, die richtigen Probleme zu erkennen, Anforderungen zu schärfen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unser Business, unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer und unsere Redaktionen wirklich einen Unterschied machen. 


Deine Aufgaben 

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und betreust unsere Webanwendungen, APIs und Apps.
  • Du arbeitest an unseren Statamic-basierten Plattformen und entwickelst unser CMS weiter.
  • Du entwickelst neue Funktionen mit unserem bestehenden Tech-Stack und verbesserst bestehende Lösungen kontinuierlich.
  • Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Einsatz und der Optimierung von Large Language Models und Coding Agents– zur Automatisierung interner Prozesse und für neue Produktfeatures.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RESTful APIs, zum Beispiel zur Anbindung von Systemen wie ActiveCampaign.
  • Du wirkst bei der Konfiguration, Wartung und Absicherung unserer Linux-Server und Deployment-Prozesse mit.
  • Du übersetzt Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in klare technische Lösungen.
  • Du bringst Struktur in komplexe oder noch nicht vollständig definierte Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen umsetzbare Produkte werden.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Stakeholdern, Produktverantwortlichen, Redaktion und Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Unser Tech-Stack - Wir arbeiten unter anderem mit: 

  • PHP und Laravel
  • Statamic
  • PostgreSQL
  • Livewire
  • HTML, CSS und JavaScript
  • RESTful APIs
  • Linux-Servern und modernen Deployment-Prozessen
  • Large Language Models und Coding Agents
Du musst unseren Tech-Stack nicht bereits vollständig beherrschen – wichtiger sind uns dein technisches Verständnis, deine Kommunikationsstärke und deine Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen schnell in gute Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du solltest aber Lust haben, mit unseren Technologien zu arbeiten und dich schnell in neue Systeme und Themen einzuarbeiten. 
Wir suchen keine Person, die jedes Tool schon einmal eingesetzt hat, sondern jemanden, der gute technische Entscheidungen trifft, Zusammenhänge versteht und Verantwortung übernimmt.


Qualifikation

  • Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und beherrschst mindestens eine relevante Programmiersprache sicher.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Webanwendungen, APIs und Datenbanken.
  • Du interessierst dich für unseren Tech-Stack und hast Lust, dich inLaravel,Statamic, PostgreSQL und Livewire einzuarbeiten oder darin weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verstehst, wie man LLMs und CodingAgentssinnvoll und verantwortungsvoll in der Softwareentwicklung einsetzt – oder möchtest es lernen.
  • Du kennst dich mit Linux-Servern,Deploymentund grundlegenden Fragen der IT-Sicherheit aus oder bist bereit, dich in diese Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme schnell erfassen, priorisieren und in konkrete nächste Schritte übersetzen.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und gerne – auch mit Menschen, die nicht technisch arbeiten.
  • Du kannst unterschiedliche Anforderungen und Perspektiven zusammenbringen und sicher mit Stakeholdern umgehen.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn Anforderungen sich verändern, Informationen zunächst unvollständig sind oder mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, in solchen Situationen Ruhe, Struktur und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Kommunikation im Team und mit unseren Stakeholdern unerlässlich.

Was uns wichtig ist

Wir entwickeln nicht zum Selbstzweck. Unser Ziel ist Software, die unmittelbar Wirkung entfaltet: für unser Geschäft, für die Vervielfachung unserer Lizenzen und für unsere Redaktionen, die täglich anspruchsvolle Inhalte produzieren.
Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Fragen stellt und sich aktiv einbringt. Du solltest dich in einem meinungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld wohlfühlen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven aushalten und deine eigenen Ideen überzeugend vertreten können. Gleichzeitig ist uns wichtig, dass du pragmatisch bleibst und gemeinsam mit anderen zu guten Lösungen kommst.


Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

  • Eine Schlüsselposition in einem innovativen und wachstumsstarken Medienunternehmen
  • Die Möglichkeit,unseren Tech-Stackaktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

title: Commercial Account Executive, DACH
Senior Key Account Manager
Product Designer | SimpleStudy
description:
Role: Senior Product Designer

Company: SimpleStudy

Location: Remote, Europe (preferably Western / continental); relocation to Lisbon possible

Job Type: Full-time

About SimpleStudy

SimpleStudy is an AI exam prep platform that students find and choose for themselves.

In some numbers:

  • 1.5M+ students across the UK, Ireland, Brazil, South Africa, and Australia

  • 40–50k new students every week

  • Web, mobile, and desktop apps

  • $4M seed round with investors from Strava, OpenAI, and Meta

The traction came fast. Now the company is refounding: rebuilding the brand, the design language, and the product experience from scratch. The product grew like a Jenga tower, one feature on top of another. The job now is to rebuild it as a pyramid.

The team is ~30 people, remote with a Lisbon office — lean, product-led, and deliberately not a typical edtech company.

You'll report to José, the Founding Designer, and work with him as a partner. José tends to lead early framing and direction. You bring strong craft and take the work to the finish line, in close sync with engineering. You both shape the new design language, and you push back with a better idea when you see one.

What you are expected to do:

  • Shape the new design language and brand: design system, rebrand, and the new mobile app.

  • Own the full design process — from an ambiguous problem to a polished, shipped solution.

  • Drive the consumer experience: onboarding, social features, retention, and the learning loop.

  • Work in close sync with engineers and PM, not as a handoff step - polish the implementation together until it feels right.

  • Bring your own initiatives and say "no, but…" when you see a better way.

  • Raise the bar for the whole design team.

What you need to succeed:

  • High craft — your visual work is polished and intentional; the details reveal your thinking.

  • Storytelling over process — you take an ambiguous problem, frame it, and make it simple. Your portfolio shows artifacts, not diagrams; it has a point of view.

  • Consumer instinct — you've shipped B2C products that people chose to use. You understand product metrics and use them as input, but you lead with feel and craft.

  • Opinions with backbone — you have a design philosophy, can defend it under pushback, and bring your own initiatives. You don't wait to be told what to build.

  • Energy and curiosity — you're an interesting person with a life outside work, and you leave people energised after a conversation.

  • English — fluent, written and spoken.

What would be a plus:

  • A standout specialty: prototyping, illustration, animation, or motion.

  • Experience with social or viral product mechanics.

  • Background at consumer companies like Spotify or Strava.

  • Early-stage or founding designer experience.

  • Comfortable in code: prototyping or polishing the front end.

What you get:

  • Build from scratch, at scale — a new design language for a product already used by 1.5M+ students.

  • A strong partner - work closely with José, the Founding Designer (ex-Shopify), with direct access to the founders.

  • Equity — generous stock options, early enough for them to matter.

  • Remote Europe — work from where you choose, with in-person meetups three times a year; relocation support if you want to move to Lisbon.

  • Competitive salary — no fixed budget, flexible.

How to apply:

A deck or a walkthrough video is fine. Show the work, keep it curated.

title: (Junior) Finance Manager (German Speaking) (m/w/d)
description:
DEINE ROLLE

Zahlen sind für dich kein Selbstzweck, sondern die Grundlage guter Entscheidungen? Du willst kein kleines Rädchen in einer großen Finanzabteilung sein, sondern echte Verantwortung und tiefe Einblicke in die Abläufe eines FinTechs? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Als (Junior) Finance Manager (m/w/d) arbeitest du in einem schlagkräftigen, kleinen Finance Team direkt mit dem VP Finance zusammen – und übernimmst von Tag eins an Verantwortung. Von der laufenden Buchhaltung über Monats- und Jahresabschluss bis zu Reporting, Forecasts und der Automatisierung unserer Prozesse deckst du die gesamte Bandbreite ab – und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit bei Management, Investoren und Board ankommt. So entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis der finanziellen Steuerung eines der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter Europas – und prägst sie aktiv mit.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Monatsabschluss: Du übernimmst eigenständig wiederkehrende Reporting- und Abschlussaufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass unser Monatsabschluss steht – pünktlich und verlässlich

  • Jahresabschluss: Du bringst dich in die Vorbereitung des HGB Jahresabschlusses ein und unterstützt unsere Accountants und Wirtschaftsprüfer beim Audit.

  • Reporting: Du erstellst KPIs und Finanzkennzahlen für Management-Präsentationen und wirkst an Investoren- und Board-Unterlagen mit.

  • Analysen: Du baust Finanzmodelle, Forecasts und Abweichungsanalysen und machst aus Zahlen belastbare Insights.

  • Prozessautomatisierung: Du digitalisierst und automatisierst unsere Finanzprozesse u.a. über AI Anwendungen – und findest die Tools, die uns morgen schneller machen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Erfahrung & Qualifikation: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und/oder ein Studium. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Accounting/Controlling, Consulting, Investment Banking oder Venture Capital ist ein Vorteil.

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Zahlen sind dein Zuhause: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest sicher in Excel und findest dich schnell in Tools wie NetSuite, Abacum, Moss oder PowerPoint zurecht. Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und AI Tools ist ein Plus – vieles davon lernst du bei uns on the Job.

  • Mindset: Du bringst eine proaktive, sorgfältige und detailorientierte Arbeitsweise mit und blühst in einem dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Startup Umfeld auf. Du bist ambitioniert, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und ziehst Dinge eigenständig durch.

  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1) und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Arbeitskontext wohl.

So geht es für dich weiter

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes virtuelles Kennenlernen mit Larissa: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Interview mit Jessie: Wir tauchen tiefer in die Rolle und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten ein und lernen uns noch besser kennen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Fragen zu stellen und mehr über das Internship zu erfahren.

  • Case Study Runde: Gemeinsam mit Jan und einem weiteren Senior Teammitglied wird auf eine typische Situation eingegangen, die Dir in dieser Rolle begegnen könnte. So bekommst Du den bestmöglichen Einblick in den praktischen Alltag.

  • Kennelernen vor Ort: Besuche unser Berliner Büro, lerne die Menschen persönlich kennen, mit denen du eng zusammenarbeiten wirst, und bekomme ein echtes Gefühl für unsere Kultur, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere gemeinsamen Ziele.

 

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

 

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Executive Business Partner (m/w/d)
description:
About us

We're on a mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. We close critical skill gaps in the workforce, in AI, data, engineering and more, through applied, guided and equitable learning programmes with measurable impact. Multiverse works with over 1,500 leading companies globally to solve business-critical skills challenges. We launched in Germany this year via our acquisition of StackFuel and our ambition is big: upskill 100,000 learners as soon as possible.

The role

Multiverse Germany's MD Office is looking for a proactive, tech-forward and experienced Executive Business Partner (m/w/d) to support the Managing Director (MD) and Chief of Staff (CoS), to help run a fast-growing Berlin office. Executive and business operations support is the core of this role: your responsibility will lie in managing the diary of the MD and other senior leaders, helping to drive our overall business operations and company rhythm. With competing priorities inevitably arising, this role will require you to use your judgment to prevent unnecessary involvement of the MD in day-to-day situations or proactively involve him or the CoS when urgent. You'll also work closely with the UK team to keep Multiverse Germany aligned with company-wide rhythms.

In addition to that, you’ll have the option to help build a high-performance, high-agency culture (e.g., owning the internal event calendar and other initiatives) in the Berlin office. In doing all of the above, automation with AI runs through all of what you’ll do. Wherever a process is repeatable, you're expected and excited to use AI tools to speed things up.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the MD primarily and provide additional support to other senior leaders, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently

  • Maintain and refine internal processes that support the MD, leadership team and the company

  • Manage professional and personal scheduling for the MD, including calendar management, preparing agendas, drafting emails, preparing phone calls or customer meeting briefings

  • Manage the MDs and senior executives’ travel logistics and activities, including accommodations, transportation, and meals

  • Assist and manage all logistics from end-to-end of small to larger scale events, for example, company All-Hands, leadership offsites or one-off customer events

  • Coordinate closely with the UK and build relationships with UK-based Executive Business Partners, Business Operations Managers and teams so Germany stays aligned with company-wide meeting rhythms and conventions

  • Automate where you can and use AI tools to cut manual admin across scheduling, reporting and follow-up

Who you are:

  • You are comfortable in a constantly evolving environment: you can operate in a highly changing, fast-paced environment and prepare decisions, even when things are ambiguous and you can hold multiple threads at the same time

  • You are a strong communicator: you know when to raise a challenge, but even more so, you solve operational challenges them proactively before they reach the CoS or MD

  • You've done this before: several years as an EA, business or operations coordinator, or similar, ideally supporting leaders in a fast-paced or scaling environment

  • You think like an operator: you don't just execute tasks, you build the process, tracker or system behind them: every challenge is a problem about to be solved

  • You default to automation: you look to cut repeatable admin with AI tools rather than doing it by hand

  • You're discreet and trusted: you handle sensitive information with sound judgement

  • You're native or fluent in German, with strong conversational English: this is needed to coordinate closely with the UK team

OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades: Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.

This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.

You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.

The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

  • Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

  • Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

  • Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

  • Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

  • Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

  • Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

  • Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

  • Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

  • Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

  • Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

  • Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas, from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

  • Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products, including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

  • Strong customer discovery and product judgment, with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment, with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

  • Proven cross-functional ownership, working closely with Engineering and UX from discovery through production and managing dependencies across teams.

  • English at C1 level and German at C2 level.

  • Willingness to stay close to customers and the team, including field discovery with tradespeople and regular presence in Hamburg (approximately one week per month or equivalent).

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with voice, mobile, or document AI, particularly products that turn unstructured inputs into reliable workflows.

  • Experience with AI monetisation, including usage-based, credit-based, or hybrid pricing models.

  • Background in B2B SaaS for SMBs, field service, construction, or the trades.

  • Familiarity with product and research tools such as PostHog, Sentry, Dovetail, or ProductFruits.

  • Additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you want to build rather than inherit.

You like starting with an important but not fully defined problem and creating clarity through customer insight, data, experimentation, and strong product judgment. You’re excited by AI because of the problems it can solve — not simply because the technology is new.

You’re comfortable working closely with engineers, understanding technical requirements and evaluation results, and translating them into sound Product decisions.

You want meaningful ownership. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, narrowing a large opportunity space into the right first wedge, shipping it, learning from real usage, and changing course when the evidence tells you to.

And importantly, you want your work to have a visible outcome. The products you build here should change how trades businesses operate — and their adoption, customer value, and commercial impact will be measurable.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) – AI-Native Development
description:
Was wir tun

Als IoT Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 40 Kollegen*innen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden.
Aktuell sind weltweit über 500.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet.

Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner etabliert.
Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen.
Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine(n) Fullstack Software Engineer (M/W/D) an den Standorten GARBSEN (bei Hannover), BISSENDORF (bei Osnabrück) oder Berlin


Deine Aufgaben

Du willst nicht nur Features abarbeiten, sondern Anwendungen als Ganzes verstehen, gestalten und weiterentwickeln?

Bei der INSIDE M2M GmbH entwickelst du anspruchsvolle Softwarelösungen für unsere IoT-Plattform. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt in Angular und TypeScript – und du entwickelst den Fluss durchgängig über Backend-Services mit Java und Quarkus – bis hin zu den Devices.

KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Handwerk, nicht zum Hype. Du setzt sie souverän ein, bewertest ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verantwortest Qualität, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit deines Codes.

  • Du entwickelst komplexe Angular-Anwendungen mit sauberer Komponentenarchitektur – von der Konzeption bis zur produktiven Nutzung.

  • Du arbeitest an den dazugehörigen Backend-Services in Java und Quarkus und gestaltest die Schnittstellen zwischen Frontend und Plattform mit.

  • Du integrierst KI-gestützte Coding-Tools und Coding Agents fest in deinen Workflow.

  • Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen, Code Reviews und die Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team, unseren Kunden und weiteren technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung.

  • Ausgeprägte Praxis in Angular und TypeScript sowie gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java und Quarkus im Backend.

  • Vertrautheit mit REST-APIs, Datenbanken und ORM.

  • Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests, inklusive E2E-Testing.

  • Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Coding-Workflows – z. B. mit Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du kannst erklären, welche Prompts, Setups und Guardrails bei dir funktionieren – und wo die Grenzen liegen.

  • Gutes Gespür für Softwarearchitektur, Codequalität und langfristig wartbare Lösungen.

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift – für die Zusammenarbeit mit Team und Kunden zwingend erforderlich.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse für technische Dokumentationen und internationale Tools.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Hintergrund in der Entwicklung oder Weiterentwicklung einer IoT-Plattform

  • Erfahrung mit verteilten Systemen, Gerätedaten, Messaging oder technischen Schnittstellen

  • Kenntnisse in Docker, Kubernetes und Cloud-native Development

  • Vertrautheit mit CI/CD, Observability oder Platform Engineering

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Erzähl uns gerne, an welchen Softwarelösungen du bisher gearbeitet hast und wie du KI-gestützte Werkzeuge in deinem Alltag einsetzt.

description:

Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

  • Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung

  • EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios

  • JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec

  • KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands

  • Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen

  • Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Entwicklungspfade – z. B. vom SDR zum Account Executive

  • Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland

  • Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür

  • Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam!

ÜBER UNS

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.

Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür.

Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns.

Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt.

title: Senior Account Executive (Germany)

We are a global HubSpot, AI, marketing & creative consultancy enabling mid-market and enterprise businesses move faster, adapt smarter, and innovate freely—by building their business around HubSpot’s CRM. We believe in striking a balance between professionalism and being human.

👀 Who we're looking for:
An experienced person to manage all new business opportunities from multiple sources (inbound, self sourced, outbound, vendor relationships, referrals) from initial connect through to close including managing the discovery of requirements, building a proposal and commercial/contractual negotiations.

The ideal candidate will be an experienced marketing/digital consultant or a consultative sales executive, familiar with common B2B consultative sales processes having operated in digital marketing, digital transformation and CRM or MarTech industries. The Account Executive will also be responsible for day-to-day reporting on pipeline and forecasts.

The goal is to grow revenue through:

  • Qualifying inbound leads and managing them through the sales process.
  • Identifying target companies and running outbound sales cadences to decision makers and influencers, managing the relationship and spotting opportunities to move into the sales process.
  • Maintain and grow relationships with HubSpot sales and customer success employees in order to become a trusted partner to help close new customers and retain existing customers together.

🚀 Key Performance Areas:
Management of Prospects and Customers in the Sales Process to Reach Set Target

  • Taking a prospect or customer from expressed interest though the Huble sales process, following all the identified steps and adapting where necessary to close the deal including:
    • Conducting Discovery Meetings
    • Coordinating a consultative approach and participating in proposition, commercial and proposal development
    • Building presentations and presenting solutions and commercials to prospective customers
    • Responding to RFP’s and Tenders
    • Negotiating commercial and contractual terms 
  • Conducting demonstrations of the HubSpot platform.
  • Developing a plan to reach and exceed sales targets set.

Reporting on Sales Process

  • Recording and keeping all data related to your sales activities in Huble systems such as HubSpot and spreadsheets.
  • Submitting accurate forecast reports.
  • Report on levels of activity and plan to reach sales targets.

Sourcing of Leads

  • Working closely with the Huble marketing team to ensure inbound leads are being generated in your territory.
  • Responsible for identifying prospects (matching our ICP) from alternative sources that result in qualified opportunities.
  • Manage outreach programs to decision makers and influencers from  prospects identified from above exercise, on successful connect built relationships.
  • Through relationships with target accounts, identify opportunities that can move into the sales process outlined in areas of responsibility #1.  
  • Build relationships with the HubSpot Sales Team, Channel Team and Customer Success Teams so that they come to you and Huble for assistance in closing new customers together and retaining and growing existing customers together. 
  • Use your personal network and existing customers to gain referrals to new potential customers. 

🏗️ To excel in this role, you should have the following:

  • Proven experience and success in a B2B sales role in a digital consultancy or agency or CRM software company. Or a team leader of a marketing/digital/CRM consultancy who wants to focus their career on solution design instead of delivery.
  • Technically minded with ability to conduct discovery meetings without the need for a sales engineer.
  • Tech-savvy strategist experienced in leading the pre-sales process and accurately scoping technical deliverables for high-complexity projects.
  • Ability to conduct software demonstrations.
  • Experience in negotiating with C-level executives from mid-market to large companies.
  • Confident in using the telephone.
  • Ability to build commercial solutions and proposals using a consultative approach (not only a set product list).
  • Ability to present your work and articulate succinctly.
  • Ability to drive and manage multiple internal stakeholders during sales engagements.

⚡️ These personal qualities are key to your success:

  • Always questioning and naturally curious
  • Coachability
  • Prior Success in Sales
  • Intelligence and high emotional intelligence
  • High Work Ethic
  • Domain Expertise - digital and CRM
  • Rapport Building
  • Objection Handling and Negotiation Skills
  • Ability to prioritise and work autonomously
  • Able to work in a deadline-driven environment
  • Excellent time and self-management skills
  • Excellent communication, influential and interpersonal skills with people at all levels, internally and externally 

💥Huble Values:

  • We are Human 
  • We embrace Change
  • We are Innovative
  • We solve for the Customer
  • We are Team Players

🎁 Das bieten wir dir

  • 🌍 Work from anywhere – Genieße die Freiheit des Remote-Arbeitens innerhalb deines Beschäftigungslandes
  • 👭 Quarterly Social Events – Tausche dich bei unseren vierteljährlichen Team-Events mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus
  • 🪑 Gestalte deinen idealen Arbeitsplatz – Du erhältst ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Homeoffice mit deinem bevorzugten Schreibtisch und Stuhl
  • 💻 Freie Gerätewahl – Entscheide dich zwischen einem MacBook oder Windows-Laptop inklusive Monitor und Maus
  • 🌴 Großzügige Urlaubsregelung – Erhalte 28 Urlaubstage zusätzlich zu gesetzlichen Feiertagen sowie einen zusätzlichen freien Tag für besondere Anlässe, z. B. deinen Geburtstag
  • 🧘 Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, die sich an deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse, Freizeit oder familiäre Verpflichtungen anpassen lassen

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.


Your Mission

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you own the systems behind our platform: the GraphQL API, the relational data model, the background processing that turns customer documents and spreadsheets into structured data, and the permission model that lets a single owner and a bank with hundreds of portfolios use the same product. Most of your work runs from schema design all the way to the resolver.
You partner with product, design and other engineers to make sure we build what matters - not just what you have been told to do. You take real responsibility for production: when something is slow, you find out why, whether the answer is a bad query, application code or the infrastructure underneath.
You also help us make AI reliable in production. Document extraction, long-running analysis jobs and agentic features are core to where the product is going, and we need people who make these workflows testable and dependable rather than impressive in a demo.
Our company size of ~40 people ensures that the best idea wins and political discussions are kept aside. And every line of code helps to improve the carbon footprint of real estate properties.

Tech stack: TypeScript (NestJS backend, React frontend), Hasura/GraphQL, PostgreSQL (multiple databases incl. PostGIS), queue-based job processing, AWS (ECS / Elastic Beanstalk, S3, SES, Textract), IaC, Claude but all agents welcome


What you'll own

  • Build features across our Hasura GraphQL API, NestJS and Postgres. From schema design to resolver.
  • Model complex real estate and ESG domains in relational schemas. We run several Postgres databases side by side (one of them geospatial), and schema decisions here have consequences but also positive impact.
  • Own background processing: Excel imports, document extraction, long-running analysis jobs, 3D and image processing. Queues, retries, jobs that spawn other jobs - and figuring out what to do when step 3 of 7 fails at 2am.
  • Develop our permission model. Customers range from a single owner to enterprises with organization/portfolio/building-level access.
  • Integrate LLMs into backend workflows - especially document and data extraction - and make them reliable, verifyable and testable.
  • Debug production. Navigate Grafana dashboards and traces to find out why something is slow or failing, whether in the app, the CI/build pipeline or the infrastructure.
  • Spot overgrown or overly complex parts of the codebase and simplify them without being asked. Paying down complexity is part of the job.


What success looks like

  • You have shipped features end-to-end across schema, API and background processing that our customers actively use.
  • Our async processing (imports, extraction, analysis jobs) is measurably more robust: fewer silent failures, clear retry and recovery paths, and observability that tells us what broke and why.
  • You have taken ownership of at least one core area e.g. the permission model, the job orchestration layer or the LLM extraction pipeline and are the person the team goes to for it.
  • You have raised the bar on testing and developer experience in the backend, and other engineers ship faster because of you.
  • You are a trusted sparring partner for product and the team when we decide what to build and how.


What it takes

  • You're strong with Postgres. Schema design comes naturally, you can read a query plan, and you know when the ORM is lying to you. Geospatial experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • You're fluent in typed backend TypeScript. We work in NestJS and GraphQL every day; if your experience is in a comparable stack, that's fine, you'll pick it up fast.
  • You've built real queue-based processing. You designed workers, dealt with retries and partial failures, orchestrated multi-step workflows.
  • You've designed or worked with authorization for a multi-tenant product and know where it might get hairy.
  • You'd rather have one integration test that hits a real database schema than ten unit tests mocking everything. You write the test that catches the broken migration.
  • You treat production as a debuggable system. You can navigate dashboards and traces to figure out why something is slow, and you don't treat infrastructure as someone else's problem.
  • You communicate clearly - with engineers, product and, when needed, directly with customers.
  • You speak German at C1 level or better and English fluently. Our customers are German banks and asset managers, and you will talk to them.
Bonus:

  • AWS (S3, SES, ECS, RDS, …) and IaC.

  • LLMs in production, especially document or data extraction and making it reliable for actual user workflows.

  • Data pipeline work: staged, reproducible processing, dataset versioning.

  • Mentoring or leading engineers, or wanting to grow into it.

  • Debugging tooling and build issues, not just application code. Our toolchain moves fast and is occasionally non-standard.


Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.

  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. What you build here runs in production and is what customers rely on every day. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.

  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.

  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.
30 vacation days (including company vacation) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events
